test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 29 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: 6 boys can complete a work in 18 hours. In how many hours will 16 boys complete the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

6 boys can complete a work in 18 hours.

**Formula used:**

Work = Number of Boys x Time

Work = Constant

**Calculation:**

6 boys x 18 hours = 16 boys x x hours

⇒ 6 x 18 = 16 x x

⇒ 108 = 16x

⇒ x = 108 ÷ 16

⇒ x = 6.75 hours or 6 (3/4) hours

**∴ The correct answer is option 3.**
